category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
subcategory_text: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified
implementation_examples: Protect identity assertions that are used to convey authentication and user information through single sign-on systems
Protect identity assertions that are used to convey authentication and user information between federated systems

Implement standards-based approaches for identity assertions in all contexts, and follow all guidance for the generation (e.g., data models, metadata), protection (e.g., digital signing, encryption), and verification (e.g., signature validation) of identity assertions
assessment_objectives: Determine whether identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified.
Determine whether activities are conducted to protect identity assertions that are used to convey authentication and user information through single sign-on systems.
Determine whether activities are conducted to protect identity assertions that are used to convey authentication and user information between federated systems.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
